summary: An empty archive's EOCD can declare a central-directory offset past the EOCD; new_append then writes there and grows the output to the declared offset.
The Shrink (unshrink) LZW decoder never assigns code 8191, so valid full-table streams fail to decode.
ZipStreamReader::visit never calls visit_additional_metadata and swallows the parse error, so stream extraction never applies Unix permissions.
